platforms.name: 拼多多 · 清透莫兰迪胶囊轻杂志风
platforms.aesthetic: 清透莫兰迪胶囊·高转化轻杂志风（手机小屏 0.5 秒扫读看清核心卖点，同时保持女装干净高级感，易读不廉价）
platforms.headline_font: 现代端正几何无衬线（思源黑体 / 阿里巴巴普惠体 SemiBold，字重 600，正体不倾斜，无粗黑描边，28–36pt）
platforms.body_font: 干净现代无衬线（Noto Sans SC Regular/Medium，字重 500，14–16pt，行距宽松）
platforms.badge_style: 圆角柔雾胶囊标签（10px 圆角，暖燕麦/浅杏半透底 #EFECE6，配 1.5px 极简细线图标与短卖点词）
platforms.prompt: Clean high-clarity womenswear conversion typography on warm off-white background (#F7F5F2, secondary #EFECE6). Upright modern geometric sans-serif headline (Noto Sans SC SemiBold, weight 600, #2D2D2D, no italic tilt, no black stroke). Selling points presented in soft rounded-pill Morandi capsules (10px radius, warm oat fill #EFECE6, subtle warm taupe accent #8C6A56) with delicate thin-line icons. Generous breathing room, zero supermarket-flyer clutter.
avoid: 遮挡服装领口或印花的贴纸

platforms.name: 淘宝/天猫 · 暖调轻奢画册风
platforms.aesthetic: 暖调轻奢画册风（法式/韩系松弛感与品牌画册呼吸感）
platforms.headline_font: 优雅高对比衬线体（Noto Serif SC / Didot / Playfair Display 风格，字距 2px，28–40pt）
platforms.body_font: 现代纤细无衬线体（Noto Sans SC Light/Regular，14–16pt，色号 #6B6259）
platforms.badge_style: 主标题下方配 1.5px 香槟金细装饰线（#C4A574，长约标题宽度 50%），卖点用无框极简细线图标排布
platforms.prompt: Warm editorial lookbook typography on cream background (#F5EFE6, secondary #EBE2D5). Refined high-contrast serif headline (Noto Serif SC / Didot style, deep espresso #3A2F27, letter-spacing 2px) with a delicate 1.5px champagne-gold underline accent (#C4A574). Subtitles and feature callouts in clean modern sans-serif (#6B6259) with minimalist thin-line icons and magazine-grade whitespace.

platforms.name: 京东 · 都市品质规格美学
platforms.aesthetic: 都市品质规格美学（突出面料克重、支数、防晒指数与工艺严谨感）
platforms.headline_font: 利落现代黑体（Noto Sans SC Bold，字重 700，端正对齐，28–36pt）
platforms.body_font: 无衬线正文 + 英文/数字等宽参数副标（Inter / Roboto Mono 风格，12–15pt）
platforms.badge_style: 极简微圆角参数胶囊（4px 圆角，浅云灰底 #F2F3F5，克制灰蓝 #7A8B99 或砖红 #B85D57 点缀）
platforms.prompt: Precision urban quality typography on crisp white background (#FFFFFF, secondary #F5F6F8). Sharp modern sans-serif headline (Noto Sans SC Bold, #1A1A1A) paired with clean monospace parameter badges (4px radius pill tags in #F2F3F5, slate accent #7A8B99, subtext #5E5E5E). Structured grid alignment, clear fabric and craftsmanship data hierarchy.

platforms.name: 抖音/小红书 · 买手店种草笔记风
platforms.aesthetic: 买手店种草笔记风（原生感、高审美留白、视觉种草直觉）
platforms.headline_font: 现代几何无衬线大字（字重 600，少字精炼）或时尚杂志衬线短标题（26–36pt）
platforms.body_font: 极简无衬线短签（13–15pt），仅保留 2–3 个核心穿搭/面料词
platforms.badge_style: 原生感半透白底短胶囊或 1px 细线圆圈局部指引，自然融入画面负空间
platforms.prompt: Boutique buyer-note editorial typography on airy pale mint-grey (#F3F6F4, secondary #E8EFEA). Clean modern geometric sans-serif short headline (#2A2A2A) with sage green accent (#7A9E8A) and minimalist thin-line pointer circles placed in natural negative space. Native social-editorial feel, effortless and uncontrived.

platforms.name: Amazon · 国际目录级净版美学
platforms.aesthetic: 国际目录级净版美学（首图 100% 纯净无字；副图/A+ 采用欧美高端百货目录排版）
platforms.headline_font: 经典英文衬线体（Playfair Display / Didot 风格）或干净几何无衬线（Helvetica Neue / Inter，28–36pt）
platforms.body_font: 清爽英文无衬线（Source Sans Pro / Inter，14–16pt，#6B6B6B，行距 22px）
platforms.badge_style: 无底框极简细线图标 + 1px 大地棕装饰分割线（#8B7355），大面积留白
platforms.prompt: International department-store catalog typography (English only on secondary/A+ screens; zero text on hero packshot). Refined serif or clean Helvetica/Inter heading (#111111) with understated earth-tone line accent (#8B7355), paired with muted grey sans-serif labels (#6B6B6B) and generous 48%+ whitespace.
avoid: 首图出现任何文字/角标/徽章/水印

platforms.name: Shopify / 独立站 · DTC 极简画廊美学
platforms.aesthetic: DTC 极简画廊美学（克制字号、高留白、当代独立品牌调性）
platforms.headline_font: 现代几何无衬线（Inter / SF Pro Display / Space Grotesk，字距 0.5–1px，24–34pt）
platforms.badge_style: 1px 极细浅灰分割线（#E5E5E5）与无框微标签，零多余装饰容器
platforms.prompt: Contemporary DTC brand lookbook typography on gallery off-white (#F8F7F4, secondary #EFECE6). Clean geometric sans-serif (Inter / SF Pro style, #1A1A1A, subtle 0.9 opacity) with 1px hairline dividers (#E5E5E5) and expansive negative space. Minimalist, modern, zero promotional clutter.
